source: Actual untouched original scripts, deterministic event/frame clocks and live WebGL uniforms

geometry.vertex: attribute vec3 aPosition;uniform float uYaw;uniform float uPitch;uniform vec2 uPointer;uniform float uAspect;varying float vGlow;void main(){float cy=cos(uYaw),sy=sin(uYaw),cx=cos(uPitch),sx=sin(uPitch);vec3 p=vec3(aPosition.x*cy+aPosition.z*sy,aPosition.y,-aPosition.x*sy+aPosition.z*cy);p=vec3(p.x,p.y*cx-p.z*sx,p.y*sx+p.z*cx);float depth=3.15-p.z;vec2 projected=p.xy/depth*2.45;vec2 clip=vec2(projected.x/uAspect,projected.y);float proximity=1.0-smoothstep(.045,.32,distance(clip,uPointer));float facing=.35+.65*(p.z*.5+.5);gl_Position=vec4(clip,p.z*.08,1.0);gl_PointSize=(1.0+1.4*facing)*(1.0+1.7*proximity);vGlow=clamp(facing+proximity*.5,.12,1.0);}
geometry.fragment: precision mediump float;varying float vGlow;void main(){vec2 q=gl_PointCoord-.5;float d=length(q);if(d>.5)discard;float core=1.0-smoothstep(.08,.5,d);vec3 color=mix(vec3(.27,.40,.37),vec3(.58,.73,.66),vGlow);gl_FragColor=vec4(color,core*(.25+.75*vGlow));}

geometry.vertex: attribute vec3 aPosition;uniform float uTime;uniform float uEnergy;uniform float uAmplitude;uniform float uAspect;uniform vec2 uTilt;varying vec3 vNormal;varying float vWave;void main(){vec3 p=aPosition;float wave=sin(p.x*4.2+uTime*1.1)+sin(p.y*5.1-uTime*.83)+sin(p.z*6.3+uTime*.67);wave/=3.0;float impulse=sin((p.x+p.y-p.z)*9.0-uTime*3.4)*uEnergy;float displacement=wave*uAmplitude+impulse*.14;p*=1.0+displacement;float cy=cos(uTilt.x),sy=sin(uTilt.x),cx=cos(uTilt.y),sx=sin(uTilt.y);p=vec3(p.x*cy+p.z*sy,p.y,-p.x*sy+p.z*cy);p=vec3(p.x,p.y*cx-p.z*sx,p.y*sx+p.z*cx);float depth=3.25-p.z;vec2 projected=p.xy/depth*1.80;gl_Position=vec4(projected.x/uAspect,projected.y,p.z*.08,1.0);vNormal=normalize(p);vWave=wave+impulse;}
geometry.fragment: precision mediump float;varying vec3 vNormal;varying float vWave;void main(){vec3 light=normalize(vec3(-.45,.65,.8));float diffuse=max(0.0,dot(vNormal,light));float rim=pow(1.0-max(0.0,vNormal.z),2.4);vec3 dark=vec3(.047,.060,.071),bright=vec3(.42,.46,.49),rimColor=vec3(.65,.72,.76);vec3 color=dark+bright*pow(diffuse,.82)*.72+rimColor*rim*.055+vWave*.012;gl_FragColor=vec4(color,1.0);}
